title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1996 An analysis of the expenses made on prison inmates in the various States/UTs reveal that maximum amount was spent mainly on providing food for inmates. Uttar Pradesh (1113.10 lakhs), Andhra Pradesh (810.63 lakhs), Tamil Nadu (686.75 lakhs), West Bengal (610.62 lakhs), Maharashtra (591.90 lakhs), Madhya Pradesh (526.84 lakhs), Karnataka (469.66 lakhs) and Orissa (421.63 lakhs) spent a larger quantum of their resources under this head.
